ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 70% high-intensity white/off-white pixels and 30% low-intensity black and dark-brown pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field; large tan-colored contiguous blob on the medial-lower quadrant of the left lobe; dense black splotch surrounding the median notch extending down the central peduncle axis; multiple thin, high-contrast black linear streaks on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical bounding box relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe shows fine-to-medium frequency serration with pixel amplitudes of 5-10 units; Right lobe exhibits a high-amplitude jagged indentation near the notch with irregular peaks towards the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a generally concave curvature from the notch to the tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of dark, circular pixel groupings located on the extreme distal tip and edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal black rake mark on the left lobe; a series of 4-5 parallel, horizontal black linear markings on the inner right lobe near the trailing edge trauma.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular trauma/indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, accompanied by dense black parallel scarring patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive tan-colored (diatom) pigmentation across the mid-section of the left lobe, creating a distinct tripartite color profile (white-tan-black).
